title: Context file frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter required on every .context/<typology>/*.md file produced by scripts/create-context-file.sh.

title.description: Human-readable title matching the H1 heading.

type.description: Singular form of the typology folder (findings/ -> finding, plans/ -> plan, guides/ -> guide, follow-ups/ -> follow-up, merge-requests/ -> merge-request, tickets/ -> ticket, decisions/ -> decision, notes/ -> note, research/ -> research). Must stay in sync with KNOWN_TYPES and singular_of() in scripts/create-context-file.sh. A one-off typology created with --allow-new-type intentionally falls outside this enum; extend it only when that typology is promoted into KNOWN_TYPES.

date.description: Creation date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), set once by the generator. Do not update on subsequent edits.

status.description: Lifecycle status. The generator always writes active; flip to done once the file is retired, closed, or actioned (see the lifecycle column in references/typologies.md).

tags.description: Free-form tags. The generator always emits this key, writing an empty array (tags: []) when no --tags were given.

related.description: Relative paths to related .context files. Omit the field entirely if there are no related files -- never emit related: [].
